def kap_flow_rows(brief: KAPFlowBrief) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
    return [
        {
            "Yayın zamanı": item.published_at.astimezone(ISTANBUL).strftime(
                "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"
            ),
            "Önem": item.importance_score,
            "Hisse": ", ".join(item.symbols) or "—",
            "Portföy teması": ", ".join(item.portfolio_symbols) or "—",
            "Tür": item.event_type,
            "Bildirim": item.headline,
            "Olay": item.event_title,
            "KAP doğrulaması": (
                "Kaynak adı" if item.source_match == "source_name" else "kap.org.tr"
            ),
            "Referans": item.source_reference or "—",
            "Olay kimliği": item.event_id,
            "Haber kimliği": item.news_id,
        }
        for item in brief.disclosures
    ]

def _fetch_targeted_fund_disclosures(
    fund_codes: Iterable[str],
    timeout_seconds: int,
) -> object:
    from datetime import date, timedelta
    import json
    from urllib.request import Request

    resolved = _resolve_kap_fund_oids(
        fund_codes,
        timeout_seconds,
    )
    if not resolved:
        return []

    today = date.today()
    start = today - timedelta(days=365)

    payload = {
        "fromDate": start.isoformat(),
        "toDate": today.isoformat(),
        "fundTypeList": sorted({
            fund_type for fund_type, _oid in resolved
        }),
        "mkkMemberOidList": [],
        "fundOidList": [
            oid for _fund_type, oid in resolved
        ],
        "passiveFundOidList": [],
        "disclosureClass": "",
        "isLate": "",
        "subjectList": [],
        "discIndex": [],
        "fromSrc": False,
        "srcCategory": "",
    }

    request = Request(
        "https://www.kap.org.tr/tr/api/disclosure/funds/byCriteria",
        data=json.dumps(
            payload,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            separators=(",", ":"),
        ).encode("utf-8"),
        headers={
            "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0",
            "Accept": "application/json, text/plain, */*",
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
            "Origin": "https://www.kap.org.tr",
            "Referer": "https://www.kap.org.tr/tr/bildirim-sorgu",
        },
        method="POST",
    )
    decoded = _json_request(request, timeout_seconds)
    if not isinstance(decoded, list):
        raise KapFundPortfolioError(
            "KAP_DISCOVERY_JSON_NOT_LIST"
        )
    return decoded
